description: Best DeFi yields (APY) for a given token symbol, across all chains and protocols, highest first, source DefiLlama — for an agent asking 'where's the best yield for my USDC/ETH/...?'. Parameter: ?symbol=<token symbol> (e.g. USDC, required). Optional: ?limit=<n> (1-100, default 10). Costs $0.05 via x402 (USDC).

limit.description: Number of pools to return (1-100, default 10).

symbol.description: Token symbol to match against pool holdings (e.g. USDC, WETH).

name: get_api_defi_yields_by_token
